strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Khetha zonke izilayishi kulo luhlu (cofa kwakhona ukucima ukhetho)
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Nqakraza Yongeza i URL, cola ikhonkco, shiya elinye kule window, okanye ulayishe ezantsi ukusuka kumkhangeli zincwadi wakho nolwaleko.
strings.The new language is used after the app r: Ulwimi olutsha lusetyenziswa emva kokuba inkqubo yekhompyutha iqalise kwakhona.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Layishela phantsi egronjiweyo, iividiyo kunye nee-torrents zisebenzisa kuphela esi silinganisi (umzekelo, i-VPN yakho). Ukuba iyadideka, layishela phantsi egronjiweyo iyayeka endaweni yokusebenzisa elinye unxulumano.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent block list: a file or a https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Ii-torrents aziyi kunxulumana needilesi kulo luhlu. I-P2P, i-DAT kunye ne-CIDR zisebenza, njenge.gz. Idilesi ilayishwe ezantsi kwakhona kabini ngemini.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: Idilesi yoluhlu lokuvala kufuneka iqale nge https://
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Izinto ezintsha ezisuka kule feeds zilayishwe ezantsi xa isihloko sabo sithelekiswa nomthetho: iifayile kunye neevidiyo, kunye nee-torrents xa ii-torrents zisebenza. Umthetho udwelisa amagama amele abe kuwo wonke usihloko, okanye / iimvakalelo eziqhelekileyo /.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Layisha ezantsi izinto ezinesihloko esiqulathe onke la magama (akukho nto = yonke into)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Lahla izinto eziqulethe isihloko ngasinye salawo magama
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Layisha ezantsi kuphela izinto ezivela emva kokuba unikezelo lufakiwe
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Idilesi ye feed kufuneka iqale nge http:// okanye https://
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Xa ndisebenzisa ikhomputha, umda wokukhuphela kwi KB/s (0 = ikhubazekile)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Isantya esipheleleyo kwakhona emva komzuzu ngaphandle kwebhodi yezitshixo okanye ungeniso lwe mouse.
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Iinxuwa/Iifayili ezinxulumanisa ngaphaya kwayo (zihlukaniswe nge-comma, umzekelo. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Ikhubazekile ngokumiselweyo. Isebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho; amakhonkco asuka kwezinye iindawo azithunyelwa kwinkonzo. Isitshixo sigcinwa sifihliweyo kwaye asikho kwingxelo yokhuseleko.
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Download limit: at most this many MB (0 = no limit)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: Xa inani lifikelelwe, ulayisho ezantsi luyayeka kwaye luyaqhubeka ngokwalo xa ixesha elilandelayo liqala.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Ngenisa idilesi ye web yoshicilelo lomntu onegunya lokusebenzela omnye (http: // okanye https://) okanye umendo opheleleyo wefayile).
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Idilesi yomntu onegunya lokusebenzela omnye (kwiskripti somntu onegunya lokusebenzela omnye: idilesi ye web okanye ifayili)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Faka ipakethi nganye kwisiqulathi seefayili sayo
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Sukufaka uvimba we-package xa yonke into igqityiwe
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Ncamathisela umbhalo oneekhonkco, okanye idilesi yephepha le web kwaye unqakraze Fumana Ikhonkco. Iinxalenye zovimba ohlukanisiweyo zidityaniswe kwipakethi enye.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Gcina i-gallery yonke ngenjini ye-gallery (i-sites njenge-Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; i-engine ilayishwe ezantsi kuqala)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Qala ifestile yokuFakela kwisiqulathi seefayili endisisebenzisileyo ngexesha lokugqibela
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Yivule ikhompyutha ukusuka ephumleni ukuya ekuqaleni
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Isebenzisa i-Windows wake timer; Iinketho ze-Amandla kufuneka zivumele i-wake timers. Inkqubo kufuneka iqhube (inokuba kwitreyi).
strings.How long ago (5 min ago): Ixesha elide kangakanani na (imizuzu emi-5 eyadlulayo)
strings.Converting needs FFmpeg. MP3 uses the be: Ukuguqula kufuna i-FFmpeg. I-MP3 isebenzisa ubunjani obuguqukayo obulungileyo; i-FLAC igcina zonke iinkcukacha zesandi esithunyelwe yinxuwa.
strings.When the app starts, remove finished dow: Xa inkqubo iqala, susa ulwaleko olugqityiweyo olunefayili ecinyiweyo okanye eshenxisiweyo
strings.Settings, the download list and unfinish: Izicwangciso, uluhlu lokulayisha ezantsi kunye neendawo ezingagqitywanga zigcinwa kwi
strings.The data moves the next time the app sta: I-data ishenxisa ngexesha elilandelayo inkqubo iqala. Zonke izinto zikhopiwe kwaye ziqinisekiswe phambi kokuba ikopi edala isuse.
I-data sele ikhona kule ncwadi eneenkcukacha.
strings.Choose a folder that is not inside the c: Khetha incwadi eneenkcukacha engekho ngaphakathi kwencwadi eneenkcukacha ye data yangoku (okanye enye indlela).
strings.Put a range in square brackets: [001-100: Faka umqolo kwizibiyeli ezithe nkqo: [001-100] igcina amanani amathathu, [1-100] ayisebenzi, [a-z] isebenzisa iileta kwaye [0-100:5] ibala kwisihlanu. Uluhlu kwizibiyeli, {jpg,png}, luzama ngalinye. Imiqolo emininzi iphindaphindwa.
strings.Words find links that contain them; * an: Amagama afumana amakhonkco aqulathe; * ne? yi wildcards; i! ephambili ishiya amakhonkco ngaphandle. Umzekelo: *. jpg! * thumb *
